=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/workflow_log_analysis_deliver_report.sh:174-236 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In sections-only mode, the shallow (`fetch-depth: 1`) deliver-report checkout fetches with `--deepen=${WLA_DELIVER_SECTIONS_FETCH_DEPTH}`, which does not make the recorded `section_base_sha` reachable once the target branch has moved. As a result, `git merge-base --is-ancestor` fails and the script exits 1 with `wla_deliver_fail section_base_invalid` before `gh pr create`.
  WHY: CI on head 4571860 reproduces it in tests-system-python (2), tests-system-python (8) and tests-heal-plan-and-validation, all failing `test_delivery_sections_only_diffs_against_recorded_base` (tests/test_workflow_log_analysis_report_delivery.py:776-793) with `::error::WORKFLOW_LOG_ANALYSIS_REPORT_DELIVERY outcome=failed reason=section_base_invalid branch=auto/workflow-log-analysis-report-100-1`. This is the normal `pr_merged`/`pushed` production path, so the sections PR is never opened. Severity disagreement: BLOCKER from sonnet, gemini, minimax and glm; MAJOR from luna. Mapped to critical. Fix direction from sonnet and glm: fetch the recorded base explicitly, or use `--depth` instead of `--deepen`, and correct the `--deepen` wording in the comment at lines 202-204, agents.d/analysis-findings-p1b-deliver-audit-sections.md and changelog.d/analysis-findings-p1b-deliver-audit-sections.md.
- scripts/workflow_log_analysis_deliver_report.sh:230-236 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Every cause of a failed sections-only base check ends in the same `reason=section_base_invalid` with no detail: base not fetched, base not an ancestor of the target, base not an ancestor of the run branch.
  WHY: An operator cannot tell a fetch/depth artifact from a genuinely bad recorded base, and the reason points diagnosis at the section jobs' correct outputs. Both reviewers rated this NIT, mapped to low.
- scripts/workflow_log_analysis_deliver_report.sh:209 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The sections-only fetch is bounded at `WLA_DELIVER_SECTIONS_FETCH_DEPTH=200` (set at line 71). If the dispatch branch and the recorded base are more than 200 commits apart, the base stays unreachable and the script fails closed with `section_base_invalid`.
  WHY: Nothing in the log shows that depth caused the failure, and the only off-ramp is the `WORKFLOW_LOG_ANALYSIS_REPORT_SECTIONS_VIA_PR` kill switch. Source rated this NIT, mapped to low.
- agents.d/analysis-findings-p1-report-pr.md:2 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The Stable log prefixes registry bullet still says the `deliver-report` shapes (`outcome=pr_opened|failed|degraded`) "appear only when `commit_report` set no delivery outcome". Sections-only mode now emits them, with no `mode=` key, on `pushed`/`pr_merged` runs. glm adds that the bullet's claim that the section push steps log `outcome=skipped reason=no_report_branch` is also stale in the default configuration.
  WHY: This is documentation-contract drift only. A log consumer following the registry would treat a valid sections-only `outcome=pr_opened` line as impossible. The P1b fragment adds the new values but does not correct this bullet. All reviewers rated it NIT, mapped to low.

The three CI jobs reproduce it: tests-system-python (2) and (8), and tests-heal-plan-and-validation via tests/test_workflow_log_analysis_failure_contract.py. The sandbox `deliver_sections` test in test_workflow_log_analysis_report_pr.py passes only because main does not move. The PR adds test scaffolding but not the implementation that makes the test pass.
- requirement: The agents.d fragment for P1b must describe the actual mechanism used by the sections-only delivery (`scripts/workflow_log_analysis_deliver_report.sh`).
  expected_change_site: agents.d/analysis-findings-p1b-deliver-audit-sections.md
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/workflow_log_analysis_deliver_report.sh:lines 201-212 (sections-only fetch: `wla_sections_depth_flag="--deepen=${WLA_DELIVER_SECTIONS_FETCH_DEPTH}"` whenever `git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository` is true) together with lines 230-236 (`git merge-base --is-ancestor "${wla_sections_base}" "refs/remotes/origin/${TARGET_BRANCH}"` followed by `wla_deliver_fail section_base_invalid`) | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The deliver-report checkout is always shallow (`fetch-depth: 1` at .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml line 3709), so sections-only mode always takes `--deepen=200`. That fetch does not make the recorded base reachable once the target branch has moved, so the ancestry check fails and the script exits 1 with `reason=section_base_invalid` before `gh pr create`.
  WHY: CI on head 4571860 fails in tests-system-python (2), tests-system-python (8) and tests-heal-plan-and-validation. The failing test is `test_delivery_sections_only_diffs_against_recorded_base` (tests/test_workflow_log_analysis_report_delivery.py:792; `--depth 1` re-clone at line 788), with error `::error::WORKFLOW_LOG_ANALYSIS_REPORT_DELIVERY outcome=failed reason=section_base_invalid branch=auto/workflow-log-analysis-report-100-1`. In production the target branch usually moves during the 75-90 minute jobs, so sections are lost. Suggested fix: explicitly fetch the recorded base, or use `--depth` instead of `--deepen`, or unshallow up to the bound. Keep `section_base_invalid` for a base that really is not an ancestor, and correct the `--deepen` wording in the comment at lines 202-204 and in agents.d/analysis-findings-p1b-deliver-audit-sections.md.
- agents.d/analysis-findings-p1-report-pr.md:line 2, the Stable log prefixes registry bullet | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The bullet says the `deliver-report` shapes appear "only when `commit_report` set no delivery outcome". Sections-only mode now emits `outcome=pr_opened`, `outcome=failed reason=section_base_invalid` and `outcome=failed reason=no_section_changes` on `pushed`/`pr_merged` runs, and the new P1b fragment does not correct this.
  WHY: Documentation-contract drift. A log consumer following the registry would treat these lines as impossible.
- TASK_GAP | confidence=4 | severity=MAJOR
  Requirement: "When deep-audit and api-redundancy run ... their section commits must reach the dispatch branch through a pull request." Also: "PR mode with `pr_merged` and the run branch already deleted, where the section is delivered on a re-created run branch." The acceptance table requires all of tests/test_workflow_log_analysis_report_delivery.py to pass.
  Expected change site: scripts/workflow_log_analysis_deliver_report.sh, the sections-only fetch and base-ancestry check (lines 201-236)
  Evidence of absence: deliver-report fails with `reason=section_base_invalid` in three CI jobs whenever the target branch has moved past the recorded base. The sandbox `deliver_sections` test passes only because main does not move, so the main deliverable is not shown to work.
- HARDENING: scripts/workflow_log_analysis_deliver_report.sh lines 230-236. Before the `--is-ancestor` checks, run `git cat-file -e "${wla_sections_base}^{commit}"` and print "recorded base not present after fetch" when it fails. Keep the reason key unchanged. About 4 lines. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
